entities.summary: Uniate Church, a political institution in Belarus during Russian Empire: Partitions & Imperial Rule (1830–1905). Grew from November Uprising and First Partition of Poland (1772) — eastern Belarus to Russia. Led to the emergence of Russification & the Jewish Pale of Settlement and Belarusian National Awakening.
